The most recent one, 7WCR..., went up 871% on PumpSwap and then had its liquidity drained to $0.01 while the market-cap figure stayed at $214k. That is the signature of a liquidity pull. This token copies the same setup: its PumpSwap pool was created 6 seconds after the mint, and it has no socials, no website, no DexScreener profile and 0% of its LP locked. Buyers far outnumber sellers (1125 vs 125 unique), which fits bots or farmed buy volume rather than organic interest. GMGN flags 9 bundler wallets.
